Generated by a single background agent seeded with pilot-batch lessons (word-grouped pinyin, no sound claims on fallback components), then checked with 03-validate-batch.ts (0 errors, 12 pinyin-spacing warnings that were spot-checked and confirmed to be false positives from single-character-word sentences) plus a manual random-sample review before locking.

Generated by a single background agent. The agent itself flagged a real data-quality bug: hanziDB.csv and makemeahanzi both give 罗 (rank 392) pinyin 'luō', but CC-CEDICT and standard modern Mandarin use 'luó' (2nd tone) for every sense (surname, gauze/net/collect). Verified against CC-CEDICT directly, fixed pinyin + example sentence in this batch, and added a PINYIN_OVERRIDES map to 01-extract-frequency-slice.ts so future re-extractions stay correct. Otherwise checked with 03-validate-batch.ts (0 errors, 14 spacing warnings, all confirmed false positives) plus a manual random-sample review before locking.
